statement: Warren 2026-10-08 (GOV-008 RUN-20261008-N0065-VER2 finding S3/F1): unresolved shipment evidence rows (NULL product id) INHERIT the product line of their identity's resolved observation where one exists; truly unresolved rows (no resolved observation for the identity) are visible only to admins and stewards. The shipment_evidence_current view must choose each identity's current row before row security applies, so a hidden newer row can never surface an older one. Also approved: ANALYZE on dim_product, fact_sales_sellout, fact_inventory_distributor, fact_demand_forecast and fact_inventory_reconciliation on cip (statistics only, no data change).
